name: Amamiyatera Karen
source:
The rich daughter of the chairman.
Her grades suggest a diligent and hardworking girl worthy of praise, but she sees other students and even the teachers as human trash unworthy of her time. She has a special level of contempt for the protagonist, who somehow ended up in her private girls' academy, despite being a guy, and a commoner.
However, once the trance-application is through with her, her feelings may change...
